purpose: Quality review of a change or diff: bugs, security, load, missing tests, speed, and unnecessary code. Reads connected code, not only the diff. Ranked findings with fixes: what goes wrong, how to fix, what happens if skipped.
use_when: Reviewing a diff, PR, branch, or last commit for correctness and necessity (not standards conformance)
Checking whether a change is over-engineered or carries untested risky logic
A ranked findings report on a change, with the smallest fix for each
do_not_use_when: Conformance review against repo standards or the originating spec (use code-review)
Making changes rather than reporting on them (use ponytail)
Auditing a whole repo rather than one change (use ponytail-audit)
scope: Read the diff and connected code; changes nothing; report only.
disambiguator: Quality review of a diff/PR (bugs, load, necessity) -> this. Standards/spec conformance -> code-review. Whole-repo audit -> ponytail-audit.
